Messages.Author: John Zbyszinski
Messages.Body:
I'm working on a new deck concept that would use the Hand of Conrad,
Gather, and the Soul Gem... and of course Force of Will. Tell me if
this works.

I use Gitane to equip with the Hand of Conrad.

I bring out the Gather and name Raven. She comes out with 1 blood.
She equips the Soul Gem and then Force of Will at SUP. I then play a
Daring the Dawn at superior. She burns and the Soul Gem activates.

I then use Gitane to bring back Raven. Now... the question is... Does
the Gather still take effect?

Thanks,

John Zbyszinski
VEKN Prince of Lansdale

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
John Zbyszinski wrote:



No. A trip through the library, crypt, or ash heap removes a card's
"memory". No effects that applied to that card before (eg, the Rack)
continue.

--Colin McGuigan
